environment.fixtures: synthetic feed in tmp_path; no broker, live feed, database or network beyond 127.0.0.1
environment.browser: Playwright Chromium cache + playwright-core via node (journey test skips with a reason when absent)

verification.runs: PYTHONPATH=<checkout>/src python -m pytest tests/demo tests/packets/A10 -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs --junitxml=artifacts/A10/test-results/junit.xml

cases.title: Account switch clears prior data and reconnects only to authorized scope
cases.note: A switch is a full server render of /demo?account=<key> from a ledger narrowed to the grant; the browser check asserts 0 foreign order ids after ArrowDown+Enter. There is no streaming connection to re-open: the page polls by 60s meta refresh.

cases.title: Unauthorized deep links and aggregates fail server-side
cases.note: Ungranted ?account= is 403 on the page and on positions/orders/workers JSON; unknown is 404 (browser-checked); aggregate with no grant is 403.

cases.title: Keyboard and mobile journeys
cases.note: Tab reaches 15/15 pane controls with a visible focus ring; ArrowUp/ArrowDown+Enter switches account; at 390px the status bar keeps the account and PAPER visible.

cases.title: Invitation journey
cases.note: Not built. /demo has no login; grants come from ALGOBOTS_DEMO_ACCOUNT_GRANTS.

cases.title: Workspace selector
cases.note: Not built. One synthetic tenant (demo); only the account selector exists.

cases.title: Overview / advanced mode toggle
cases.note: Not built. /demo is a single terminal layout.

cases.title: Fixture-mode isolation for KPI / market / signal panels
cases.note: Deferred. The KPI strip reads the grant-narrowed ledger (covered structurally by test_narrow_drops_ungranted_books) but has no dedicated per-account assertion. /demo has no market or signal panels to isolate.
